terms.title: Dieu khoan dich vu
terms.article1Content: Cac dieu khoan nay quy dinh cac dieu kien va thu tuc su dung dich vu quan ly du an va cong tac do BRIDGE SPOTS ("Dich vu") cung cap, cung nhu quyen, nghia vu va trach nhiem giua cong ty va thanh vien.
terms.article2Item1: 1. "Dich vu" la tat ca cac dich vu quan ly du an, cong tac va lap lich do cong ty cung cap.
terms.article2Item2: 2. "Thanh vien" la ca nhan hoac to chuc da dong y voi cac dieu khoan nay va ky ket hop dong dich vu voi cong ty.
terms.article2Item3: 3. "Bang" la khong gian lam viec dua tren du an do thanh vien tao ra.
terms.article3Title: Dieu 3 (Hieu luc va sua doi dieu khoan)
terms.article3Item1: 1. Cac dieu khoan nay ap dung cho tat ca thanh vien muon su dung dich vu.
terms.article3Item2: 2. Cong ty co the sua doi cac dieu khoan nay khi can thiet trong pham vi luat phap hien hanh.
terms.article3Item3: 3. Khi dieu khoan thay doi, cong ty se thong bao truoc cho thanh vien thong qua thong bao trong dich vu hoac email.
terms.article4Item1: 1. Dang ky duoc hoan tat khi nguoi dung dong y voi cac dieu khoan nay, dien thong tin bat buoc va nhan duoc su chap thuan tu cong ty.
terms.article4Item2: 2. Thanh vien phai cung cap thong tin chinh xac khi dang ky; truy cap dich vu co the bi han che neu cung cap thong tin sai.
terms.article4Item3: 3. Thanh vien chiu trach nhiem bao mat thong tin tai khoan va khong duoc chuyen nhuong hoac cho muon tai khoan cua ho cho nguoi khac.
terms.article5Item1: 1. Cong ty cung cap dich vu 24/7 la nguyen tac.
terms.article5Item2: 2. Cong ty co the tam ngung dich vu de bao tri hoac cap nhat he thong, voi thong bao truoc.
terms.article5Item3: 3. Cong ty cung cap thoi gian dung thu mien phi va cac goi tra phi; tinh nang va gia cua moi goi co the duoc tim thay trong dich vu.
terms.article6Content: 1. Thanh vien khong duoc thuc hien cac hoat dong sau:
terms.article6Item1: Vi pham hoac lam dung thong tin ca nhan cua nguoi khac
terms.article6Item2: Pha vu hoat dong on dinh cua dich vu
terms.article6Item3: Su dung dich vu cho muc dich bat hop phap
terms.article6Item4: Bat ky hoat dong nao khac vi pham luat phap hien hanh
terms.article7Item1: 1. Tat ca noi dung, thiet ke va cong nghe trong dich vu duoc bao ho boi quyen so huu tri tue cua cong ty.
terms.article7Item2: 2. Quyen doi voi noi dung do thanh vien tao ra trong dich vu thuoc ve thanh vien.
terms.article8Item1: 1. Cong ty khong chiu trach nhiem ve gian doan dich vu do bat kha khang nhu thien tai, chien tranh hoac gian doan dich vu vien thong.
terms.article8Item2: 2. Cong ty khong chiu trach nhiem ve gian doan dich vu do hanh dong cua thanh vien.
terms.draftNotice: Cac dieu khoan nay la noi dung tam thoi dang cho xem xet phap ly. Chung se duoc hoan thien voi tu van phap ly chuyen nghiep truoc khi dich vu chinh thuc ra mat.

privacy.title: Chinh sach bao mat
privacy.intro: BRIDGE SPOTS ("Cong ty") coi trong thong tin ca nhan cua nguoi dung va tuan thu cac luat hien hanh bao gom Luat Bao ve Thong tin Ca nhan. Chinh sach bao mat nay giai thich thong tin ca nhan chung toi thu thap, cach chung toi su dung va cac bien phap chung toi thuc hien de bao ve no.
privacy.section1Title: 1. Thong tin ca nhan duoc thu thap
privacy.section1Content: Cong ty thu thap cac thong tin ca nhan sau de cung cap dich vu:
privacy.requiredItems: Dia chi email, ten (biet danh), mat khau
privacy.autoCollectedItems: Dia chi IP, thoi gian truy cap, thong tin trinh duyet, nhat ky su dung dich vu
privacy.section2Title: 2. Muc dich thu thap va su dung
privacy.section2Content: Thong tin ca nhan duoc thu thap chi duoc su dung cho cac muc dich sau:
privacy.section2Item1: Dang ky tai khoan va xac minh danh tinh
privacy.section2Item2: Cung cap va van hanh dich vu
privacy.section2Item3: Phan hoi yeu cau khach hang va xu ly khieu nai
privacy.section2Item4: Cai thien dich vu va phat trien dich vu moi
privacy.section2Item5: Gui thong bao lien quan den dich vu
privacy.section3Content: Thong tin ca nhan cua thanh vien duoc luu giu trong thoi gian hop dong dich vu va bi huy ngay khi xoa tai khoan. Tuy nhien, co the duoc luu giu trong thoi gian theo yeu cau cua phap luat khi luat hien hanh quy dinh.
privacy.retentionTitle: Thoi gian luu giu theo quy dinh phap luat:
privacy.retentionItem1: Ho so hop dong hoac rut lui: 5 nam
privacy.retentionItem2: Ho so thanh toan va cung cap: 5 nam
privacy.retentionItem3: Ho so khieu nai hoac tranh chap nguoi tieu dung: 3 nam
privacy.retentionItem4: Nhat ky su dung dich vu, nhat ky truy cap: 3 thang
privacy.section4Title: 4. Cung cap cho ben thu ba
privacy.section4Content: Cong ty khong cung cap thong tin ca nhan cua nguoi dung cho ben thu ba la nguyen tac. Tuy nhien, ngoai le ap dung trong cac truong hop sau:
privacy.section4Item1: Khi nguoi dung da dong y truoc
privacy.section4Item2: Khi luat phap yeu cau hoac theo yeu cau cua co quan dieu tra theo thu tuc phap ly quy dinh
privacy.section5Content: Cong ty thuc hien cac bien phap sau de dam bao bao mat thong tin ca nhan:
privacy.section5Item1: Luu tru mat khau da ma hoa
privacy.section5Item2: Ma hoa truyen du lieu qua SSL/TLS
privacy.section5Item3: Han che truy cap thong tin ca nhan
privacy.section5Item4: Kiem tra bao mat dinh ky va cai thien lo hong
privacy.section6Content: Nguoi dung co the thuc hien cac quyen sau bat ky luc nao:
privacy.section6Item1: Yeu cau xem thong tin ca nhan
privacy.section6Item2: Yeu cau sua thong tin ca nhan
privacy.section6Item3: Yeu cau xoa thong tin ca nhan
privacy.section6Item4: Yeu cau dinh chi xu ly thong tin ca nhan
privacy.section6Footer: Cac quyen nay co the duoc thuc hien thong qua menu cai dat trong dich vu hoac bang cach lien he bo phan ho tro khach hang.
privacy.section7Content: Cong ty su dung cookie de cung cap dich vu. Cookie duoc su dung de duy tri trang thai dang nhap va cai thien trai nghiem dich vu. Ban co the tu choi luu tru cookie thong qua cai dat trinh duyet, nhung mot so tinh nang dich vu co the bi han che.
privacy.section8Title: 8. Can bo bao ve du lieu
privacy.section8Content: Doi voi cac yeu cau lien quan den bao ve thong tin ca nhan, vui long lien he voi chung toi tai:
privacy.section8Officer: Lien he: Can bo Bao ve Du lieu
privacy.section9Title: 9. Thay doi chinh sach bao mat
privacy.section9Content: Chinh sach bao mat nay co the duoc sua doi do thay doi luat phap hoac chinh sach dich vu, va thay doi se duoc thong bao truoc thong qua thong bao trong dich vu hoac email.
privacy.draftNotice: Chinh sach bao mat nay la noi dung tam thoi dang cho xem xet phap ly. No se duoc hoan thien voi tu van phap ly chuyen nghiep truoc khi dich vu chinh thuc ra mat.
